tradeIdeas.title: iTraxx Asia IG CDS Protection - Reload; Compression Thesis Reversed
tradeIdeas.rationale: iTraxx Asia IG ~142bp (Jul 16 est., +2bp from Jul 14's 140bp) as Trump's Hormuz blockade and 20% cargo tribute order keeps the crisis at severe level for a 6th consecutive day of US-Iran strikes, extending the reversal of the Jun 22-23 roadmap compression trend. Reload protection to 60-70% - do not wait for a re-test of the 115-120bp target, that thesis is dead. Stress scenario (25%): iTraxx settles 150-180bp. Tail scenario (65%): spikes to 200-230bp on sustained blockade. Only reduce on a confirmed blockade lift or Iran accepting terms.
instruments: iTraxx Asia ex-Japan IG CDS 5Y (reload to 60-70%)
Sapura Energy / Hyflux bond short via CDS (add)

tradeIdeas.title: JKM-TTF Spread - Stop Out; Europe Outbids Asia for Gulf Cargoes
tradeIdeas.rationale: TTF €55.28/MWh (Jul 16, Trading Economics/ICE, +1.4% vs Jul 15) surged further while JKM $19.93/MMBtu (Jul 16, Trading Economics, +1.1%) - the opposite of the Jun 30 'JKM supply-lag premium' thesis. Qatar's extended force majeure into Aug-Sept (JOGMEC) is now pushing Europe to aggressively rebid for the same disrupted Gulf-adjacent cargoes Asia was counting on, compressing the spread that supported a long-JKM/short-TTF position. Close the spread; both markers face continued upside risk on the Hormuz blockade, but the relative-value edge that justified the JKM leg is gone. Re-evaluate once Qatar force majeure scope clarifies.
instruments: Asia LNG spot cargo purchase via intermediary (hold off)

tradeIdeas.rationale: USD/PHP ~55.75 est. (Jul 16) sits above the Jun 30 55.00 entry and never reached the 54.50-55.00 take-profit zone. USD/IDR ~15,800 est. (Jul 16) similarly stalled. The Jun 30 'deal de-escalation EM FX recovery' thesis is invalidated: Trump's Hormuz blockade and 20% cargo tribute keeps the crisis at severe level as Brent trades at $85.42, +16% from the Jun 30 $73.62 entry level.
